title: harness variant hypothesis
description: Written to harness/HYPOTHESIS.json by the improver agent for every candidate variant, and validated mechanically by improver/loop.py before a single benchmark run is spent. Three constraints cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are checked on the host instead: every target_files entry must exist in the working tree, every expected_flips id must be in the TRAIN split of bench/subset.json (the held-out split is never named in a hypothesis), and no changed line under harness/ may contain a hidden test name or instance id.

hypothesis.description: One falsifiable claim about the harness: what is changed and what that is expected to do to the train solid_fail instances. First line becomes the candidate commit subject.

target_files.description: Repo-relative paths the change touches. Must start with 'harness/' (the improver may mutate nothing else) and must already exist; a new file is added by listing the file it is derived from is NOT allowed -- create the file, then list it.

expected_flips.description: SWE-bench instance ids from the TRAIN split that this change is predicted to move from solid_fail to solid_pass. A hypothesis that predicts nothing cannot be screened; naming a held-out id is a protocol violation and is rejected.

rationale.description: Why the traces support the hypothesis: which train failures were read, what the shared cause looked like, why this edit addresses it.

category.description: Coarse kind of change, so the archive can be read as a search history rather than a list of diffs.
